#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check a physical LibTorch prefix with a native CMake consumer."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import resource
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

run = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
task = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(run/'input'))
from devtools_install import checksum, verify

prefix = Path('/opt/apps/abacus/dependencies/libtorch/2.1.2-cpu-cxx11abi1')
request = json.loads((run/'request.json').read_text())
for name, expected in request['input_sha256'].items():
    assert checksum(run/'input'/name) == expected, name
assert checksum(__file__) == request['verify_sha256']
assert not os.environ.get('APPTAINER_CONTAINER'), 'Must run directly on host'
assert not os.environ.get('SINGULARITY_CONTAINER'), 'Must run directly on host'
assert not Path('/.singularity.d').exists(), 'Unexpected container root'
start = time.monotonic()
verify(prefix, json.loads((run/'input/libtorch-manifest.json').read_text()))
(task/'mountinfo.txt').write_text(Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text())
logs = []


def command(argv, *, cwd=None, env=None):
    began = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=cwd, env=env,
                            text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    logs.append(dict(argv=list(map(str, argv)), cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None,
                     seconds=time.monotonic()-began, returncode=result.returncode,
                     output=result.stdout))
    (task/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(logs, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(result.stdout, flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Command failed: '+str(argv))
    return result.stdout


compiler = Path(shutil.which('g++')).resolve()
version = command([compiler, '-dumpfullversion'])
assert version.strip().startswith('13.'), 'Expected current ABACUS GCC13 toolchain'
command([compiler, '--version'])
command(['cmake', '--version'])
command(['lscpu'])
source = task/'consumer'
source.mkdir()
shutil.copyfile(run/'input/app_dependency_torch.cpp', source/'consumer.cpp')
(source/'CMakeLists.txt').write_text('''cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(torch_consumer LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(Torch 2.1.2 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(consumer consumer.cpp)
target_compile_features(consumer PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE "${TORCH_LIBRARIES}")
''')
command(['cmake', '-S', source, '-B', source/'build', '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release',
         '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER='+str(compiler), '-DTorch_DIR='+str(prefix/'share/cmake/Torch')])
command(['cmake', '--build', source/'build', '--parallel', '2'])
env = dict(os.environ, OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1')
env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = str(prefix/'lib')+':'+env.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH', '')
dependencies = command(['ldd', source/'build/consumer'], env=env)
(task/'ldd.txt').write_text(dependencies)
assert 'not found' not in dependencies
for library in ('libtorch.so', 'libtorch_cpu.so', 'libc10.so'):
    assert library+' => '+str(prefix/'lib'/library) in dependencies, library
result = command([source/'build/consumer', run/'input/deepks.ptg'], cwd=source, env=env)
assert 'SAI_LIBTORCH_TENSOR_JIT_PASS 2.1.2' in result
assert 'SAI_DEEPKS_MODEL_LOAD_PASS' in result
receipt = dict(passed=True, host_native=True, prefix=str(prefix),
    node=os.uname().nodename, partition=os.environ['SLURM_JOB_PARTITION'],
    job_id=os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'], compiler=str(compiler),
    compiler_version=version.strip(), compiler_sha256=checksum(compiler),
    request_sha256=checksum(run/'request.json'),
    manifest_sha256=checksum(run/'input/libtorch-manifest.json'),
    consumer_sha256=checksum(source/'build/consumer'),
    model_sha256=checksum(run/'input/deepks.ptg'),
    tensor_matmul=True, jit_roundtrip=True, abacus_deepks_model_load=True,
    physical_libtorch_ldd=True, elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
    max_child_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss)
(task/'passed.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
